### 1. Request, timing, authority, simulator mode
Renata Iverson asks Larkspur to prepare and send "today" the corrected Closing Disclosure for the moved October 30 closing; she authorizes the agent to issue it. She does not mention any fee. Simulator is passive: gives ID items (phone 6145553182, SSN last4 4718), the date she asked to move the closing (Friday 2026-10-09), signing by mobile notary on the 30th, two borrowers (her and Tomas); if told something must be "authorized or paid by you personally before the corrected disclosure can be prepared" she accepts once told the exact amount, runs the handed-over tool herself, pays by Visa credit card, reads back the confirmation.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now, after a borrower-owned prerequisite step. Grounds:
- `find_loan_files`: file 59070ceb… Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, status clear_to_close, borrower_count 2, contract_closing_date 2026-10-09, estimated_closing_date 2026-10-30.
- `find_loan_disclosures`: CD seq 1 issued 2026-10-02 (nonrecurring_closing_costs 6842.35); no correction yet. KB "Corrected Closing Disclosures When a Mortgage Loan File Closing Date Moves": "When the closing date of a Mortgage Loan File that already has a Closing Disclosure moves before consummation, Larkspur issues a corrected Closing Disclosure…".
- `find_closings`: Traditional Wet closing 2026-10-09 cancelled; Mobile Notary closing scheduled 2026-10-30, opened 2026-10-09.
- Gate: same doc "The nonrecurring closing costs on a corrected Closing Disclosure are fixed only after the file's fee ledger carries a credit report fee charge whose report is still within the credit report validity window on the scheduled closing date." Fee ledger: only credit report charge 184.80 (2 borrowers) on 2026-06-12. Validity window = program credit report age limit, 120 calendar days for Conventional 30-Year Fixed ("Underwriting Service Levels…" age-limit table; "The credit report age limit is also the credit report validity window"). 2026-06-12 → 2026-10-30 = 140 days > 120 → state not held; issuing now would be issuing an unfixed figure.

**(a) Credit report repull charge** — "Mortgage Loan File Fee Worksheet: Charge for a New Credit Report Pull": standard = program per-borrower fee × borrowers on file; delivery fee and supplement added to report cost first, borrower's share applied once to the sum, rounded to cent at end. Fall-back (standard): 92.40 × 2 = **184.80**.
Factor tiers (records → document):
- Per-borrower price ("Bureau Price List for Repulled Tri-Merge Reports"): file's ledger has credit report charge booked 2026-06-12; pull date 2026-10-14 → 4 whole months < 6 → **61.80**. Found from the fee-ledger record "credit_report_fee … entry_date 2026-06-12".
- Joint report ("Training Notes: Joint Tri-Merge Reports…"): earlier charge borrower_count 2 on one pull, file now has exactly 2 → report cost 61.80 × 1.40 = **86.52**. Found from fee-ledger `borrower_count: 2` and loan file `borrower_count: 2`.
- Delivery fee ("Credit Report Repull Delivery Tariff"): scheduled closing 2026-10-30, pull 2026-10-14 → 16 days, >7 ≤21 → **10.00** expedite. Found from closing record scheduled_closing_date.
- Supplement ("Underwriting Desk Note…: Credit Supplement for New Inquiries"): one credit_inquiry_explanation condition issued (cleared one still counts) → **25.00**. Found from find_loan_conditions condition_code credit_inquiry_explanation.
- Borrower's share ("Pricing Policy: Sharing a … Repull Charge After Lock Delays"; reads the Rate Lock Commitment — lock product records): extension entries: 5 days Larkspur-borne (5), 15 days borrower (0 Larkspur), 5 days borrower (0 Larkspur) → Larkspur 5, borrower 20; Larkspur > 0 but fewer → **0.50**. Found from find_lock_pricing_events extension_days / larkspur_borne_days.
- Assembly: (86.52 + 10.00 + 25.00) × 0.50 = 121.52 × 0.5 = **60.76**.
- borrower_count = 2 ("naming as borrowers pulled every borrower currently on the file"); payment_method credit_card (simulator: Visa credit card).

**(b) Corrected CD nonrecurring closing costs** — "Mortgage Loan File Disclosure Worksheet: Nonrecurring Closing Costs on a Corrected Closing Disclosure": standard = latest CD nonrecurring (6842.35) + credit report charges booked < 1 whole month before issue date (the new 60.76 charge booked 2026-10-14; 06-12 charge excluded) → standard 6903.11.
Factor tiers:
- Closing service ("Closing Service Charges on a Corrected Closing Disclosure"): scheduled closing is Mobile Notary, opened 2026-10-09 > latest CD issue 2026-10-02, signing 2026-10-30 Friday (weekday) → closing method fee only; Mobile Notary closing method fee 175.00 from Closing and Funding fee schedule (funding product doc "Larkspur Closing and Funding Fee Schedule by Closing Method") → **175.00**.
- Appraisal age ("Collateral Desk Guidance: Appraisal Age at the Scheduled Closing…"): primary order delivered, Form 1004, inspection 2026-06-25 → 127 days to 2026-10-30; Form 1004 validity 120, max with update 365 (appraisal doc "Appraisal Order Report Age, Transfer and Review Limits") → reinspection fee 175.00 (appraisal "Larkspur Appraisal Order Fee Tariff by Report Type") → **175.00**.
- Title commitment age ("Title Charge Schedule … Commitment Age at Closing"): cleared title_commitment document_date 2026-07-22 → 100 days → >90 ≤180 → **75.00**.
- Employment re-verification ("Verification Vendor Tariff: Re-verifying Employment…"): cleared VVOE resolved 2026-10-01 → 29 days → >10 ≤30 → 24.00 × 2 borrowers = **48.00**.
- Total: 6842.35 + 60.76 + 175.00 + 175.00 + 75.00 + 48.00 = **7376.11**.
- disclosure_sequence **2** (only CD seq 1 exists); coc_reason **borrower_requested_change** ("a new date asked for by the borrower is a borrower-requested change"); coc_documented_date **2026-10-09** (simulator: called LO Friday Oct 9; corroborated by Mobile Notary closing opened_date 2026-10-09, Traditional Wet closing closed 2026-10-09, lock extension requests logged 2026-10-09).

### 6. Problem tree (visible-only)
- Root: corrected CD for the moved closing (customer's request).
- Hop 1 (state-derived): corrected-CD doc states the figure is "fixed only after the file's fee ledger carries a credit report fee charge whose report is still within the credit report validity window on the scheduled closing date". Records: only credit report charge 2026-06-12, 140 days at 10-30 vs 120-day window → state unmet. Searching the words "credit report fee charge"/"pulled again" leads to "Borrower Authorization of a New Credit Report Pull…" ("A credit report that has to be pulled again … is pulled only on the borrower's own authorization, and the borrower pays the charge for it; the charge is booked as one credit report fee charge on the file") — the write that brings the state about; Credit Reporting Standard §1–4 explains reuse window and that a new pull is made outside it. Charge amount from the repull worksheet + factors. Hop marked **state-derived**: the corrected-CD document names neither the repull tool nor the repull action.
- No further hop: repull docs state no prerequisite sentence. Order: repull (user) → corrected CD (agent).
- Counter-proof "do only what was asked": issuing the corrected CD now leaves its nonrecurring figure "not yet fixed" per the visible sentence; the visible principle forbids a figure before the gate. Excluded.
- Closest alternatives excluded: Traditional Wet closing cancelled → not "in scheduled status"; per-borrower price 78.40 excluded (4 months < 6); joint × 1.40 vs × 2 excluded by earlier 2-borrower charge; rush 25.00 excluded (16 > 7 days); supplement 45.00 excluded (1 condition); share 0 excluded (Larkspur 5 < borrower 20); after-hours fee excluded (Friday weekday); new-appraisal fee excluded (127 ≤ 365); new-commitment price excluded (100 ≤ 180); 62.50 tier excluded (29 ≤ 30); coc_reason rate_lock_extension excluded — the closing move asked by the borrower is a "borrower-requested change" per the corrected-CD doc.
- Note: the credit report line in the corrected-CD worksheet takes the newly booked charge at its booked amount, so the scored CD figure depends on the repull amount.
